newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-REDKNAPP IS NOT FOR SALE, LIVERPOOL SAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-REDKNAPP IS NOT FOR SALE, LIVERPOOL SAY.

text.p: England midfielder Jamie Redknapp is staying at Liverpool, the club said on Wednesday.
Italian newspapers said earlier on Wednesday that Roma had made a bid for Redknapp but Liverpool said the 23-year-old midfielder was not for sale.
"Roma have expressed an interest in Jamie but we have told them he is not for sale," Liverpool spokesman Ian Cotton said. "There are no meetings planned between the clubs.
"Jamie is staying with Liverpool as the manager (Roy Evans) sees his future at Anfield."

Italian sports daily Gazzetta dello Sport had said on Wednesday that Roma, 11th in serie A, had offered 4.8 million pounds sterling ($8 million) for Redknapp and that the club president Franco Sensi was travelling to Liverpool to pursue the bid.
